title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1969-06-21

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a laid‑back yet powerful late‑1969 show with standout performances of Dire Wolf, Eleven and Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear vintage soundboard quality that lets listeners hear Jerry Garcia’s emerging Fender Strat tone and sweet pedal‑steel touches. Musically the set is a smooth transition from psychedelia to folk‑rock country, highlighted by an inspired Dire Wolf vocal, a soaring Eleven, and a beautiful Lovelight acoustic moment.

ai_rating.rationale: All eight reviews are largely enthusiastic (average 4.38★), praising both the high‑quality soundboard source and the strong musical performance, with no significant criticisms.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly call the sound "excellent" for a ’69 show, noting crisp clarity and faithful capture of instruments.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Late‑show set that bridges the end of psychedelia into a folk‑rock/country direction, featuring relaxed yet powerful playing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s sweet pedal steel and his early Fender Strat “sweet sound” are specifically praised.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby (Weir) is highlighted for singing Dire Wolf.
